comment: Pinned host tools for Tools/ShaderCook/shadercook.py. Fetched by setup.py into <host>/, which is gitignored. Binaries are hosted as release assets because neither tool publishes an upstream prebuilt for these hosts, and because a multi-megabyte binary per host does not belong in git history.

naga.pinRationale: The version pin is load-bearing: naga 29.x is the WGSL frontend inside the engine's pinned wgpu-native v29.0.1.1 (cmake/ports/wgpu-native), so WGSL this translator emits is WGSL the desktop backend validates. Bump the two together, never separately.

tint.buildRecipe: shallow clone at the pinned commit, fetch_dawn_dependencies.py, Release, ninja tint_cmd_tint_cmd with all GPU backends off
tint.pinRationale: Tint is the WGSL frontend inside Chrome: what it accepts is what ships. It is the cook's second gate after naga - it errors on uniformity violations naga only warns about.

linux-x64.unavailable: No hosted build yet - nobody has built naga and tint for linux-x64. Build both with the buildRecipe in this file, upload them to the shadercook-toolchain-v1 release as naga-29.0.4-linux-x64 and tint-36cf1fae0-linux-x64, then add their size and sha256 here.

macos-x64.unavailable: No hosted build yet - the project has no x86-64 Mac. Build both with the buildRecipe in this file, upload them to the shadercook-toolchain-v1 release as naga-29.0.4-macos-x64 and tint-36cf1fae0-macos-x64, then add their size and sha256 here.
